description: This file defines the InvalidParamException class, a custom exception in the OrangeHRM system used to handle invalid parameter errors within the API V2 module. It includes methods for managing an error bag and normalizing error information.

classes.name: InvalidParamException
classes.description: A custom exception class to represent invalid parameter errors in the OrangeHRM API version 2.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of InvalidParamException with an optional error bag, message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getErrorBag
methods.description: Returns the error bag array containing detailed error information.

methods.name: setErrorBag
methods.description: Sets the error bag array with new error details.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Returns a normalized array containing the keys of the errors in the error bag.
